verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents version history only for design documents (starred versions controlling Library updates), plus plugin publishing via skpm. It never mentions versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations such as plugins, scripts, or MCP-driven workflows. Document versioning is an adjacent feature, and plugin publishing is a developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
